# Six-Lane Evidence Ledger

The Awtsmoos sent six rays through different roads at once;
Awtsmoos.com now knows which shadows are defects, which are boundaries, and which require no false response.

## Lane 1 — structured runtime

- Piano and Docs receive one parseable JSON-LD block.
- Piano is `SoftwareApplication`; Docs and About are `WebPage`.
- Social titles follow authored document titles.
- Canonical URLs inside structured data match final public URLs.
- Reapplying the static SEO helper is idempotent.
- `/games/` itself is not enriched even though core sitemap indexes it.

## Lane 2 — static semantic coverage

- 79 generated metadata records.
- Zero missing files and zero missing titles.
- 22 authored entry documents have no H1.
- 28 authored descriptions exist; generated enrichment supplies the missing descriptions.
- No authored canonical, robots, or JSON-LD among these entry documents; central enrichment is therefore carrying those duties consistently.
- H1 remediation must remain visible/user-beneficial rather than hidden SEO text.

## Lane 3 — sitemap consistency

- Root sitemap: 7 entries.
- Core sitemap: 11 entries.
- Apps sitemap: 45 entries.
- Games sitemap: 32 entries.
- Translation sitemap index: 7 entries.
- All scanned XML parses.
- No bad hosts, queries, fragments, or redirect-prone extensionless paths.
- Duplicate crawl entries exist for apps/catalog.html and games/catalog.html because core and family sitemaps both contain them.

## Lane 4 — dynamic families

- Alias sitemap currently has one shard.
- Comment sitemap returns HTTP 200 in about 0.87 seconds and currently has zero shards because real native-comment data is absent.
- Translation corpus has 2 families, 503 bundled posts, and 416,514 rows.
- Zero missing bundles and zero duplicate row IDs were found.

## Lane 5 — generated metadata integrity

- 79 records.
- Zero file collisions.
- Zero canonical collisions.
- Zero missing files.
- Zero external canonical paths.
- Zero query or fragment canonical paths.
- No external registry entries entered the checked app/game registries.

## Lane 6 — Git/release reality

- Canonical checkout is on `main`.
- Remote advanced beyond local SEO base through unrelated commits.
- Generation-2/3 target diff itself had no incoming overlap.
- A safe `reset --keep` was intentionally blocked because newer remote commits overlap unrelated dirty Awtsmoos Studio/Nesher/tunnel mailbox files owned by concurrent work.
- Those unrelated files must remain untouched.
- Final SEO integration should therefore use a clean current-origin worktree, followed by canonical-main reconciliation only when safe.
